landing.heroDescription: AI-powered verification and blockchain traceability for a more transparent, secure, and authentic Ayurvedic supply chain.
landing.demoDescription: Watch how our platform creates an unbroken chain of trust from farm to pharmacy. Every step is verified, recorded, and easily accessible.
landing.immutableRecordsDesc: Every transaction and quality check is permanently recorded on the blockchain, eliminating the possibility of fraud.
landing.integratedLabReportsDesc: Instantly access AI-verified quality certificates and lab test results for every batch of raw materials.
landing.farmToConsumerDesc: Empower consumers to trace the complete journey of their Ayurvedic products by simply scanning a QR code.
landing.howItWorksSub: Swipe through the 5 stages of Dravya's Ayurvedic supply chain verification.
landing.step1Desc: Farmers log raw herb origin, geo-location, and harvest batch data directly onto the platform.
landing.step2Desc: Certified labs verify heavy metals, purity, moisture levels, and authenticity metrics.
landing.step3Desc: Manufacturers process herbs into formulations with full environmental and parameter logs.
landing.step4Desc: Distributors and retailers maintain temperature, custody, and real-time location logs.
landing.step5Desc: End consumers scan a QR code on packaging to view the complete lab & journey audit trail.
landing.aiDesc: Dravya replaces manual inspection with advanced computer vision. Our models instantly identify medicinal herbs, detect impurities, and cryptographically anchor the results to the blockchain.
landing.intelligentRecDesc: Scans biological markers to identify exact species and varieties with over 99.8% precision, ensuring authentic sourcing.
landing.qualityAssessmentDesc: Automatically flags visual defects, discoloration, or potential foreign contaminants in the batch before processing.
landing.immutableLoggingDesc: Verification data is hashed and permanently stored, creating an unalterable proof of origin on the blockchain.
